provenance.source_state: Working tree changes; no commit or push performed.

limits: Fast means first qualifying resolver result; it is not a runtime comparison of decoded frame latency.
First-frame measurements use decoded FFmpeg progress at 50 ms intervals, not a GUI paint measurement.
Three distinct episodes, eight-second native decodes. Prior research separately includes repeated trials and 60-second decodes.
Fast race selects 720p AniWaves in these cases; ReAnime is 1080p with required English track index 1.
Container language metadata is inspected; probabilistic speech checks confirm sampled dialogue, not every catalog title.
Cache timings show immediate repeated resolution in one Engine, not a five-minute longevity test.
ReAnime English verification currently supports bounded Matroska/WebM headers; missing raw probe support or incomplete/unsupported track metadata does not qualify.
Later AniWaves seasons require explicit matching season titles. Uncertain matches are rejected.

reproduce.fast_cli: TMDB_API_KEY=... cargo run -p vsources-cli -- resolve tmdb:209867 --kind series --season 1 --episode 2 --english-dub --fast --json
reproduce.english_1080p: TMDB_API_KEY=... cargo run -p vsources-cli -- resolve tmdb:209867 --kind series --season 1 --episode 2 --provider reanime --english-dub --json
